call_points.text: Closed FY26 with preferred bidder status worth over $400 million in the Middle East and Africa region.
Middle East funding for new projects has been scaled back, delaying them about 6 to 8 months; ongoing projects and payments are unaffected.
Shipping costs and transit times have risen and ports are congested, a minor supply-chain impact management expects to manage.
About 70 to 80 projects are under execution at any time: roughly 15-20 abroad and 50-60 in India.
Plans to build more than 100 compressed biogas plants over the next few years, helped by the new GOBARdhan scheme.
BLUE SEED: took a 10% equity stake in Bengaluru-based Nimble Vision in April 2026 and is evaluating more startups.
Credit rating reaffirmed at IND AA- stable long-term and A1+ short-term.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹5 per share for FY26, up from ₹4 the previous year.
Revenue growth guardrail held at 15-20% and EBITDA margin at 13-15% until a new strategy is published.
Kuwait award expected next month and the Saudi one the following quarter; WABAG is lowest evaluated bidder on both.
Free cash flow to firm was almost ₹300 Cr for FY26.
Price variation clauses cover about 70% of costs on long Indian projects; international contracts generally lack them.
The Asia's largest desalination plant is expected to be commissioned around this time next year.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹5 per share, up from ₹4, for shareholder approval.
India cluster revenue was flat at about ₹1,860 Cr; CFO said EPC phasing distorts quarters and to judge on blended multi-year margins.
Gulf geopolitics, government spending cuts, currency and raw material volatility named as headwinds.
Municipal platform talks are close but no news this quarter; management asked investors to wait another quarter.

ROCE to cross 20% in the next couple of years

operating_notes.text: O&M backlog is almost 40% of the ₹17,200 Cr order book, about ₹6,500 Cr, with contracts of 5 to 20 years.
Net working capital days are around 100 and ROCE 19.4% for FY26.
Al-Haer 200 MLD STP in the Middle East is at 83% physical progress and on track for commissioning.
Order book of over ₹17,200 Cr at FY26 year-end, about US $1.8 billion, with over 35% from long-term O&M contracts of 15-20 years.
About 70-80 projects under execution at any time: roughly 15-20 abroad and 50-60 in India.
Closed FY26 with preferred bidder status worth over $400 million in the Middle East and Africa region.
